artifacts.scoring_queue.parquet: Main Phase-2 input — (query_idx, doc_id, doc_text, dist_to_gt, is_gt, rag_failed)
artifacts.pool_embeddings.npy: float32 [1431 × 768] — pool doc embeddings in pool_doc_ids.json order
artifacts.pool_doc_ids.json: Ordered list of doc IDs; row i matches pool_embeddings.npy[i]
artifacts.pool_metadata.parquet: PMID, title, text_snippet per pool doc
artifacts.gt_embeddings.npy: float32 [10 × 768] — GT embedding per query; row = query_idx - 1
artifacts.gt_doc_ids.json: GT doc ID per query; index = query_idx - 1
artifacts.queries.json: Full query list used in experiment
